text:
58세 남성, esophageal varices로 인한 severe gastrointestinal bleeding으로 입원함.

Vital signs:
- BP 90/60 mmHg
- HR 120 bpm
- RR 24 breaths/min
- BT 36.8°C
- SpO2 92% on room air

Severe hemorrhage 확인됨.

Octreotide 50 mcg IV q6h 투여 중.

Oxygen support: nasal cannula at 2 L/min 적용함.

Endoscopic band ligation 시행함.

Foley 유지함.

Strict monitoring of input and output.

Clinical status: drowsy 상태 확인됨.

Gastroenterology team notify함.
